title: Nyxbot onboarding
providerUnavailable: {{provider}} sign-in is not available in this environment yet. Please use another sign-in method.
signedIn: You're signed in to NyxID. Continue to connect your data and channel.
signinUnavailable: Sign-in options could not be loaded. Please retry.
sourceIntro: Connect your files and booking calendar.
nyxbotReturnUnavailable: The link to your Nyxbot conversation is not available yet.
sourcePermissions: Drive and Calendar are authorized together. This permission is separate from signing in to NyxID.
sourceHelp: Connect Google Workspace to authorize Drive and Calendar together. Nyxbot can access the Drive files you choose and manage calendar events. You can revoke access in NyxID.
googleCancelled: Google authorization was cancelled or could not be completed. Your sign-in is preserved. Please retry.
googleConnectFailed: We couldn't open Google authorization. Your sign-in is preserved. Please retry.
googleIncomplete: Drive and Calendar access is still required. Connect Google and grant both permissions to continue.
googleUnavailable: Google Drive and Calendar authorization is not available yet. Your account is signed in, but access to your files and calendar has not been granted.
loadError: We couldn't load your connections. Please retry.
channelIntro: Pick the channel customers will use, and connect it.
channelHelp: Connect your business's customer-facing channel. Your Telegram business bot is separate from the Nyxbot guide that sent you here. Connecting a channel does not make automated replies live.
telegramName: Give your bot a name and a username ending in _bot.
telegramPaste: Copy the bot token and paste it below.
tokenRequired: Paste the bot token from BotFather.
tokenInvalid: Invalid Telegram bot token format. Copy the complete token from BotFather and try again.
tokenNote: Your token is stored securely in NyxID.
channelFailed: Your channel could not be connected. Check the token and retry.
channelPending: Your bot was saved, but its webhook is not ready yet. Finish channel setup in NyxID before linking your chat.
whatsappHelp: Meta handles authorization in its own window. Sign in, select your business account, and verify your number. Your monthly spending cap must be saved before Nyxbot can enable automated replies.
whatsappLogin: Sign in with Facebook in Meta's window.
whatsappNumber: Choose your business account and phone number.
whatsappVerify: Verify the number by SMS or call, then approve access.
whatsappUnavailable: WhatsApp setup is not available yet. Your progress is saved; you can come back later or choose Telegram.
capDescription: Choose a monthly limit for WhatsApp messaging.
capHelp: The selected cap must be enforced by the service. At the limit, automated replies stop while incoming messages continue. The owner is notified. Choosing a value here does not activate a budget.
capUnavailable: Monthly spending limits are not available yet. WhatsApp has not been activated, and this choice has not been saved.
linkSubtitle: Link this channel to your account
linkIntro: Send the code to Nyxbot to link your chat.
linkHelp: A pairing code links your chat to this setup. Codes expire after 10 minutes. On WhatsApp, opening the link prefills the code; you still need to send it. Linking does not enable automated replies.
linkUnavailable: Your channel is saved. Chat linking is not available yet, so a pairing code cannot be issued. Return later to finish linking.
linkThen: Then Nyxbot helps you set things up
